**REQUIRED FIXES**

**Blocker 1 — live sysfs BTF reads lack privilege.** `btf_raw` (run_lifecycle.py:172) invokes `bpftool btf dump` without `sudo -n`, but it is called on root-only module BTF files: `capture_core` (run_lifecycle.py:473, `/sys/kernel/btf/nvidia`) and `live_uvm_interface` (run_lifecycle.py:493, `/sys/kernel/btf/nvidia_uvm`). Module BTF sysfs attributes are mode 0400 (only `vmlinux` is world-readable), and the repository's own precedent dumps the identical file with `sudo -n` (run_safety.py:383; the MoE runner does the same). Since the coordinator runs unprivileged (the admitted command has no `sudo` prefix, per prefetch-uvm-lifecycle-plan.md:21), admission will fail at `live_uvm_interface`/`capture_core` (run_lifecycle.py:937, 941) and again in every recovery `validate_old`/`validate_old_pre_service`/`final_validation` path that needs the live dump (run_lifecycle.py:698, 710). The failure is fail-closed and occurs strictly before any destructive step, so it is not a safety violation, but the campaign cannot reach its destructive phase at all: not ready for one live campaign. Fix: add `sudo -n` in `btf_raw`; no test exercises this argv shape.

All other audited properties hold:

1. **Leases:** acquired exactly once via `LifecycleLeases` (run_lifecycle.py:57-82) with `O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW`, no create/write; identity/ownership rechecked before acquisition, after acquisition while held (run_lifecycle.py:896, 920-922), and at publication
